name: passwordHashVerify
description: Verifies a plaintext password against a hash created by passwordHashGenerate(). The algorithm, cost parameters and salt are read from the hash itself. It also verifies hashes created by the deprecated generateBCryptHash() and generateSCryptHash().

params.name: hash
params.description: The stored hash to verify against.

params.name: algorithm
params.description: The algorithm the hash was created with.

coldfusion.notes: Introduced in ColdFusion 2025 Update 8. Replaces the deprecated verifyBCryptHash() and verifySCryptHash().

links.title: OWASP Password Storage Cheat Sheet
links.description: General advice from OWASP about how to store passwords.

examples.title: Verify a password at login
examples.description: Hashes a password, then checks a correct and a wrong password against the hash.

examples.title: Verify a hash from the deprecated BCrypt function
examples.description: Hashes created with generateBCryptHash() can be checked with the new function.
